newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle in limited test - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle in limited test - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower in a light test, compared with Monday's close, USDA said.
Trade was slow and demand light to moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 65.50-66.00.
On a carcass basis (weight only) compared with Monday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00-$2.00 lower in a limited test.

Steers - Select and Choice 2-4 1150-1275 lbs 106.00-107.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 102.00-104.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
